authorization: 기존 정책과 모델은 그대로 두고 기존 실측 자료로 하강·장시간 온도 예측 보완 및 상승·하강 정확도 개선 비교
stage: Second development candidate after preserving first56 linear fits. No heldout independence claim.
rationale: Linear residual cannot separate condition-dependent correction; first trend-weighted candidate lowered long-horizon error but worsened rise/fall. Test one fixed nonlinear correction, not a parameter sweep.
baseline: Frozen pipeline_thermal_v1 group-excluded predicted-power-driven thermal OOF, 208 sessions; preserve all previous models and gate FAIL
data: Exact same208 sessions and25975 AP observations; no eligibility promotion; same27 outer groups
inputs: known activity9 phase intervals supplied equally to baseline and candidates
predicted capacity power from existing outer-group-excluded power model
prohibited_inputs: post-anchor measured AP or future power as predictor features
hidden simulator progress or future actual arrivals
architecture: Current passive baseline + histogram gradient-boosted tree residual, signed empirical surrogate; not physical R/C identification or temperature clipping.
train_weights: N_samples/(N_train_sessions*N_samples_in_session), so sessions have equal total weight
leakage_control: For each heldoutG, existing power modelG and existing thermal modelG excludeG. Recompute baseline and input features for ALL train/test sessions with these same outerG models. Never train correction on other OOF rows whose base models includedG.
primary: This one candidate fixed before its fits; no OOF parameter selection
metrics: Reuse exact baseline10s +/-0.2C measured labels/windows and session-macro MAE/direction; report OLD/M8/R21 and t>=256s, sensitivity thresholds unchanged
joint_goal: Primary candidate must lower overall/rise/fall/late MAE and not lower rise/fall direction to claim simultaneous improvement; otherwise report partial gain or failure, no gate promotion
interpretation: Conditional known-activity development OOF. An empirical residual may improve prediction without proving physical validity; old gate FAIL preserved. All first-stage and second-stage results reported.
anchor_constraint: Residual = (1-exp(-(t-anchor)/10)) * learned residual. Exact0 at anchor. Train target residual/gate with sample weights multiplied by gate^2, equivalent to level squared loss; no clipping.
